items.stem: What must every cloud flow contain to be saved?

options.text: At least a trigger and one action
options.rationale: Correct: a cloud flow needs a trigger and at least one action to be saved.
Bicep is an Azure IaC tool, not required for flows.
A storage account is not required to save a flow.
Approvals are optional actions, not a save requirement.

items.stem: Which TWO are valid Power Automate cloud flow types? (Select TWO.)

options.rationale: Correct: automated flows run when a trigger event occurs.
Correct: scheduled flows run on a defined recurrence.
GRS is an Azure Storage redundancy option, not a flow type.
Conditional Access is an Entra feature, not a flow type.

options.rationale: Correct: run history shows each run's status and lets you inspect failures.
Cost management does not show flow run status.
NSGs are networking controls, not flow diagnostics.
Access tiers are unrelated to flow run status.
